prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently performed poorly across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Adding wait-time information on the home screen was helpful across 4 winning tests, while 3 tests showed no clear effect.

Changes to sign-in copy, sign-in hints, choose-path copy, finish new-flow flows, and sign-in notifications consistently showed no clear effect across 2 or more tests each.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for categories with only 1 test or split outcomes, such as single-test changes or split layout results.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that yielded no clear effect or performed worse.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] waiting_screen_pet_care_preview_flow: Introduce an interactive pet care minigame flow during the waiting screen where users can practice feeding and grooming their pet while background rendering completes. (why: The waiting step has a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s). Providing interactive engagement during waiting keeps users active and reduces drop-off.)
1: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_visibility_spotlight_redesign: Redesign home_intro using a spotlight layout to highlight the desktop tray icon and visibility toggles. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show on the desktop or the app will not open, and completion takes a median 395s.)
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_asset_download_wait_info: Display explicit wait-time estimates and asset loading status on the waiting screen. (why: Home/waiting screen median duration is 201s (mean 2336s). Providing wait-time guidance has consistently improved completion across past winning tests.)
3: [adoption, hint] pick_friend_trait_selection_hint: Add trait comparison hints to pet selection cards showing how companion personalities behave on the desktop. (why: Adoption has an 87.7% completion rate with median 89s; clearer behavioral hints reduce hesitation during selection.)
4: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_pet_restore_hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring returning users that logging into their account restores previously adopted pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top customer issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_flow_preview_layout: Change the choose_path layout to a split presentation contrasting standard pet adoption against photo custom pet generation. (why: choose_path initial conversion is 78.8%; a clear side-by-side comparison helps users pick the right creation path instantly.)
6: [home, notification] waiting_screen_desktop_launch_notification: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen to alert users when pet initialization is complete. (why: The mean wait time is 2336s, causing users to switch windows. System notifications bring users back when rendering finishes.)
